spell.welcomescreen.fireball.desc: Hurls a blazing fireball that bursts on impact, burning and knocking back every foe around it. Water puts it out.
spell.welcomescreen.lightning_strike.des: A storm gathers over your target, then lightning strikes, stuns foes close by and leaps on to up to 3 more (5 in the rain).
spell.welcomescreen.wind_gust.desc: Blasts a gale forward that throws foes back, turns their arrows round and blows loose items away. Softens your fall.
spell.welcomescreen.poison_area.desc: Shatters a vial into a bubbling cloud of poison that slows every foe inside; the longer they stay, the worse it bites.
spell.welcomescreen.void_walk.desc: Step into the void: invisible, silent and fast. Your first blow out of it strikes 50% harder and leaves the foe reeling.
spell.welcomescreen.welcome_tip: Feel free to send me whatever you want! I can make simple spells within 3min. Think of something and let me know, and I'll try to make it ASAP!

config.welcomescreen.title: Multiverse Powers
config.welcomescreen.expand.desc: Unfold every part of this page.
config.welcomescreen.collapse.desc: Fold every part of this page shut, so you only see the titles.
config.welcomescreen.apply.desc: Save every change on every tab; the screen stays open.
config.welcomescreen.steps: Hold shift for 10 steps at once.
config.welcomescreen.locked: The settings file is not open, so nothing can be saved here.
config.welcomescreen.server_decides: These are this server’s world settings: only the server can change them.
config.welcomescreen.world_closed: World settings belong to a world: open one of your own to change them. Every world keeps its own.
config.welcomescreen.world_help: World settings: saved with this world only, the same for everyone who plays in it. Point at a line to read what it does.
config.welcomescreen.client_help: Your own settings: only in your own game, in every world. Point at a line to read what it does.
How hard your view shakes and jolts from the powers: a slam, crash or blast nearby, a sword blow, the beam, the ring arriving. 1 = as made, 0 = never.
config.welcomescreen.client.ramGroundSha: How hard your view shakes while you fly with the ram cone low along the ground (0 = not at all); the camera shake scales it too.
config.welcomescreen.defaults.desc: Put every number in the list back to what the mod has. Nothing is saved until you apply or save.
config.welcomescreen.cooldown.desc: How long you wait before you can use it again.
config.welcomescreen.damage.desc: How much its main hit does, in half hearts.
How much stamina a full bar holds.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.sprintDrain: Stamina sprinting costs per tick (20 ticks = 1 second).
config.welcomescreen.stamina.regenPerTic: Stamina that comes back per tick while you rest.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.regenDelayT: How long you have to rest before stamina comes back.
config.welcomescreen.stamina.exhaustionR: Stamina you need again before you can sprint after running out.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.giant: Damage of the smallest fist (a tap), in half hearts.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.light: Damage of one Light Bolt, in half hearts.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.shock: Damage of the shockwave in the middle, in half hearts; at its edge half of it.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.air_s: Damage of the plane's crash in the middle of the blast, in half hearts; at its edge half of it.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.giant: Damage of a smack, in half hearts; a throw does 0.6 of it, a slap flat 1.3, every blow of a pound 0.55, a middle finger bursting out of the ground 2.5, and the axe of a pair of hands 3 in the middle of its blow (half that at its edge). Each hand's own Damage below multiplies this.
config.welcomescreen.green_lantern.light: Damage the creature in a bubble takes from the last slam when you pound it into the ground, in half hearts (the two slams before it deal a third of it each); what stands round it takes half.
screen.welcomescreen.title: Welkom
screen.welcomescreen.group_hint: Where your power comes from. Click to see its classes.
screen.welcomescreen.class_hint: How you use that power. Click a class to pick it.
screen.welcomescreen.notice.title: ⚠ Your class is not a cage ⚠
screen.welcomescreen.notice.body: Your class only decides your skill tree: how you grow and which powers you unlock. It never locks anything away. A Knight can still cast spells, a Wizard can still wear heavy armour, and anyone can use any weapon, potion or item from any group.
screen.welcomescreen.notice.short: ⚠ Your class only shapes your skill tree. Every weapon, spell and item stays open to you.
screen.welcomescreen.inventory.hint: Your class shapes your skill tree only - nothing is locked.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.lore: No gods, no spirits, no tricks - just a body trained to survive where others break.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.power: Your own body. Armour, weapons and endurance - no magic at all.
group.welcomescreen.warriors.pick: you want to be in the middle of the fight and simply hit hard.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.lore: They know the wild better than themselves: a bow, an animal, and the land itself.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.power: The wild. Range, animals, traps and knowing the land.
group.welcomescreen.rangers.pick: you like fighting from a distance, exploring, or having a companion.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.lore: They live off what others do not see. No honour, no rules - only what works.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.power: Stealth and cunning. Surprise, speed and dirty tricks.
group.welcomescreen.rogues.pick: you want to strike first, stay unseen and never fight fair.
group.welcomescreen.mages.lore: Arcane power, gained in four ways: learned, born, borrowed and taken.
group.welcomescreen.mages.power: Magic. Spells that hit hard from range, in a fragile body.
group.welcomescreen.mages.pick: you want big spells and can keep enemies away from you.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.lore: Their power does not come from themselves, but from what they believe.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.power: Faith. Healing, holy light and power against the undead.
group.welcomescreen.faithful.pick: you want to protect, heal, or hunt what should not exist.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.lore: They rarely fight head-on - they win another way.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.power: Potions and powders. Healing brews, poison, bombs and crafting.
group.welcomescreen.alchemists.pick: you like preparing, brewing and winning with the right mix.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.lore: Wakes up with nothing, and no memory of who he was.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.power: A little of everything: fragments of all six groups.
group.welcomescreen.forsaken.pick: you want no fixed role and the hardest possible start.
class.welcomescreen.knight.lore: The wall - still standing when everyone else falls.
class.welcomescreen.knight.special: Draws enemies to himself and blocks with shield and heavy armour.
class.welcomescreen.knight.pick: you want to survive anything and protect others.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.lore: The more he bleeds, the more dangerous he gets.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.special: Rage: hits harder the lower his health is.
class.welcomescreen.berserker.weak: Little defence - easy to push too far.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.lore: Calm, patient, deadly - a long pole with a sharp end.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.special: Long reach: hits enemies before they can hit back.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.strong: Keeps enemies at a safe distance.
class.welcomescreen.halberdier.pick: you like controlled fighting and good positioning.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.lore: Wins by never getting hit - then strikes at the perfect moment.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.special: Dodges and parries, followed by a strong counter-attack.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.strong: Very hard to hit in a one-on-one fight.
class.welcomescreen.duelist.pick: you want skill and timing over raw strength.
class.welcomescreen.archer.lore: By the time something notices him, it is already too late.
class.welcomescreen.archer.special: Precise bow shots from long range.
class.welcomescreen.archer.strong: The most damage from a distance.
class.welcomescreen.archer.pick: you want to kill things before they reach you.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.lore: Never fights alone - something loyal and wild walks beside him.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.special: Animal companions that fight beside him and grow with him.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.weak: Weaker on his own when his animal falls.
class.welcomescreen.beastmaster.pick: you want a loyal animal partner.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.lore: Wins the fight before it starts. The ground is his weapon.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.special: Traps and snares that slow, catch and hurt enemies.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.strong: Very strong when prepared, great for defence.
class.welcomescreen.trapper.pick: you like planning ahead and luring enemies in.
class.welcomescreen.scout.lore: Sees everything before anyone else does.
class.welcomescreen.scout.special: Speed, sharp sight and spotting danger early.
class.welcomescreen.scout.strong: The fastest explorer, finds things first.
class.welcomescreen.scout.weak: Low damage in a straight fight.
class.welcomescreen.scout.pick: you love exploring and moving fast.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.lore: Invisible until it is too late. One mistake is enough.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.special: Sneak attacks from hiding that deal massive damage.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.strong: Kills a single target very fast.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.weak: Fragile if the first strike fails.
class.welcomescreen.assassin.pick: you want to strike once, hard, from the shadows.
class.welcomescreen.thief.lore: Every door has a lock, and every lock has a way in.
class.welcomescreen.thief.special: Lockpicking and stealing: more loot, fewer fights.
class.welcomescreen.thief.strong: Gets rich fast and avoids danger.
class.welcomescreen.thief.pick: you care more about treasure than about fighting.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.lore: Waits in the shadow of the road.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.special: Ambushes with crossbow shots and surprise attacks.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.strong: A deadly first strike from range.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.weak: Weak in a long, open fight.
class.welcomescreen.highwayman.pick: you like ambushes and a crossbow.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.lore: Walks in where nobody may enter, and leaves no trace.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.special: Sneaks past guards into places others cannot reach.
class.welcomescreen.infiltrator.pick: you want to sneak instead of fight.
class.welcomescreen.wizard.lore: Learned it all from books, and is never done learning.
class.welcomescreen.wizard.special: Many kinds of spells: fire, ice, light and more.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.lore: Born with magic nobody taught him.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.special: Fewer spells than a Wizard, but much stronger ones.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.weak: Few options, needs rest to recover.
class.welcomescreen.sorcerer.pick: you want pure, raw magic power.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.lore: Borrowed his power from something that is not human.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.special: Strong dark spells that always come with a price.
class.welcomescreen.warlock.pick: you like risk and dark power.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.special: Raises the dead and curses enemies. Grows with every kill.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.strong: An army of minions, stronger in long fights.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.weak: Weak alone, and weak at the start.
class.welcomescreen.necromancer.pick: you want an army of the dead.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.lore: Without him, a hard fight falls apart.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.special: Healing and blessings for himself and others.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.strong: The best at keeping everyone alive.
class.welcomescreen.cleric.pick: you want to keep others standing.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.lore: A Knight's armour, but he fights with faith, not steel.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.special: Heavy armour plus holy power against evil.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.strong: Tough, and extra strong against undead.
class.welcomescreen.paladin.pick: you want to be a holy warrior.
class.welcomescreen.inquisitor.special: Extra strong against the undead and forbidden magic.
class.welcomescreen.inquisitor.pick: you want to hunt the undead and the dark.
class.welcomescreen.monk.lore: Needs no weapon and no armour - only discipline.
class.welcomescreen.monk.special: Fights with fists and speed, stronger without gear.
class.welcomescreen.monk.pick: you want a pure challenge without gear.
class.welcomescreen.apothecary.lore: Unremarkable, until the moment everyone needs him.
class.welcomescreen.plague_doctor.lore: Makes the enemy weaken itself before the fight starts.
class.welcomescreen.plague_doctor.specia: Poison and sickness that wear enemies down over time.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.lore: Subtlety is not his strong suit.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.special: Bombs that hit many enemies at once.
class.welcomescreen.bombardier.weak: Dangerous up close - also to himself.
class.welcomescreen.transmuter.special: Changes materials into other, more useful ones.
class.welcomescreen.transmuter.pick: you like crafting and building more than fighting.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.lore: No group claims him. He does not know himself where he belongs.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.special: Fragments of skills from every group.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.strong: The most flexible: can grow into anything.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.weak: Starts with nothing, no clear strength.
class.welcomescreen.forsaken.pick: you want the hardest start and total freedom.
screen.welcomescreen.construct_pick.help: Click one: a second later it strikes in front of you, shockwave and all.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.fist.desc: A giant fist smashes down out of the sky, knuckles first.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.hands.desc: Two giant hands clap together in front of you.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.fists.desc: Two giant fists bump knuckles in front of you.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.hammer.desc: A war hammer drops head first; sparks fly.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.emblem.desc: The lantern emblem stands up and falls flat on its face.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.anvil.desc: An anvil drops, squashes, throws sparks and hops once more.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.cymbals.des: Two cymbals crash together and ring.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.uppercut.de: A giant fist bursts up out of the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.spikes.desc: Two rings of crystal spikes shoot up out of the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.boot.desc: A boot stamps down heel first; the toe slaps after.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.weight.desc: A cartoon ton weight drops with a heavy squash.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.sword.desc: A sword drops point first and stays in the ground, quivering.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.rockets.des: Five rockets arc over your head and come down one after another.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.swatter.des: A fly swatter swings over your shoulder and slaps the ground flat.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.lantern.des: Your lantern drops, its handle swinging.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.safe.desc: A safe drops, its door flies open and money spills out.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.anchor.desc: An anchor drops; its chain comes down after it and piles up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.mace.desc: A spiked ball tumbles down and rocks in the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.barbell.des: A barbell drops on its plates and bounces.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.bell.desc: A bell drops on its rim and rings, its clapper swinging.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.meteor.desc: A burning meteor streaks in and slams into the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.palm.desc: A giant open hand slaps the ground; its fingers drum after.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.gavel.desc: A judge's gavel strikes its block, and knocks once more.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.pickaxe.des: A pickaxe swings over your head and bites into the ground.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.trap.desc: The jaws of a bear trap snap shut.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.book.desc: A giant book flips its pages and slams shut.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.drum.desc: Two drumsticks strike a drum and play a roll.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.pillar.desc: A pillar bursts out of the ground and topples; its drums come apart.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.tnt.desc: A bundle of dynamite lands, its fuse burns down, and it blows up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.piano.desc: A piano drops; its lids fly open and notes float up.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.brick.desc: A giant toy brick drops and bounces.
construct.welcomescreen.slam.stamp.desc: A rubber stamp stamps the lantern emblem into the ground.
